important_instructions: The appointments are on contract basis against temporary project posts. Appointment will be made for the various projects until March 2027. If a candidate's work is not found satisfactory, the Centre reserves the right to end the contract at any time. The positions end automatically once the fixed period of the projects is over. A candidate engaged under the project has no possibility of absorption or regularisation in any post at the Uttarakhand Space Application Centre. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The Centre reserves the right not to fill the vacant posts. The decision of the Director, U-SAC, is final and binding in all matters.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: USAC has advertised 5 posts in total. Each post has its own qualification, age limit and pay, as shown below. Essential qualification: Post Graduate degree with 55% marks from any recognised university in Remote Sensing and GIS / Environment Science / Geoinformatics / Life Science / Forestry / Geography / Earth Science / Hydrology and Physics subject. Reserved category candidates: a minimum of 50% marks is required. Desirable: Preference will be given to researchers who have: appropriate knowledge of RS/GIS related software; experience of field work in areas of Uttarakhand; experience of working in various image processing, remote sensing and GIS based projects or industries; experience of working with GPS; appropriate computer knowledge. Age limit: maximum 28 years for the general category. Essential qualification: Graduate degree from any recognised university and appropriate computer knowledge. Desirable: basic knowledge of operating a computer and experience of working in the hilly areas of Uttarakhand. Age limit: maximum 42 years for the general category. The age limit is 28 years for Junior Project Fellow (JPF) and 42 years for Field Assistant. Age is counted as on 1 January 2026. Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Other Backward Class candidates get age relaxation as per rules. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification. faq.question: Q1. When is the USAC walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The Uttarakhand Space Application Centre walk-in interview for Junior Project Fellow and Field Assistant is on 4 November 2026 at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in USAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 4 for Junior Project Fellow and 1 for Field Assistant, under Advertisement No. 10/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for USAC Junior Project Fellow?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate degree with 55% marks from any recognised university in Remote Sensing and GIS, Environment Science, Geoinformatics, Life Science, Forestry, Geography, Earth Science, Hydrology and Physics subject. Reserved category candidates need a minimum of 50% marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for USAC Field Assistant?
faq.answer: Field Assistant candidates need a graduate degree from any recognised university and appropriate computer knowledge. Basic computer operation skills and experience of working in the hilly areas of Uttarakhand are desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for USAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years for Junior Project Fellow and 42 years for Field Assistant (general category), counted as on 1 January 2026. SC, ST and OBC candidates get age relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of USAC Junior Project Fellow and Field Assistant?
faq.answer: Junior Project Fellow gets a fixed Rs. 24,000/- plus House Rent Allowance at 16% per month. Field Assistant gets Rs. 18,000/- plus House Rent Allowance at 16% per month.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the USAC walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring an application addressed to the Director, Uttarakhand Space Application Centre, Dehradun, your original records, other certificates, your Aadhaar card and a passport-size photograph. Photocopies of all certificates and the Aadhaar card, plus a photograph, must be attached to the application.

faq.question: Q8. Is the USAC Junior Project Fellow job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on contract against temporary project posts until March 2027, and they end automatically when the projects finish. There is no possibility of absorption or regularisation at USAC.

faq.question: Q9. Will USAC pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
